candidate_reports.remark: Public report of a jack-knifed rig near Glenn Highway weigh station. News media reports that by 9 AM_ Anchorage Police Department had received 22 car crash reports_ including one that resulted in non-life-threatening injuries.
28 to 32 inches of snow reported between mile markers 30-35 on the Richardson Highway.
24 inches of snow reported between miles markers 24 and 29 on the Richardson Highway. Winds of 50 mph caused blowing snow and limited visibilities_ especially between 10 PM and 3 AM.
